pages.supportReplyA: Most messages are reviewed during working hours, with order and delivery questions prioritized.
pages.sizeHelpQ: Can you help me choose a size?
pages.sizeHelpA: Yes. Send your training style, product choice, and fit preference so support can guide you.
pages.trackOrderQ: Where can I track my order?
pages.trackOrderA: Order status is available from your profile orders page after checkout.
pages.faqTrackQ: How can I track my order?
pages.faqTrackA: You can track order status from your profile orders page after placing an order.
pages.faqChangeQ: Can I change my order after checkout?
pages.faqChangeA: Contact support as soon as possible. Changes depend on whether the order has already been prepared for shipping.
pages.faqShippingA: Shipping usually takes between 2-5 business days depending on your city and courier availability.
pages.faqInternationalA: International shipping can be arranged depending on destination, product size, and courier restrictions.
pages.faqPaymentA: Cash on delivery is currently supported. Online payment can be added when payment provider integration is enabled.
pages.faqSecureA: The checkout experience is designed around a protected order flow and clear confirmation details.
pages.faqReturnA: Yes. Returns are accepted within 14 days when the product is unused, clean, and returned with original packaging.
pages.faqDamagedQ: What if my item arrives damaged?
pages.faqDamagedA: Contact support with your order details and product photos so the team can review the issue quickly.
pages.faqSizeQ: How do I choose the right size?
pages.faqSizeA: Use the product page size options and contact support if you need help matching gear to your training style.
pages.faqBeginnerA: Yes. Viking Store carries gear suitable for beginners, regular gym training, and experienced fighters.
pages.faqAccountQ: Do I need an account to order?
pages.faqAccountA: You can browse freely, and account features help you view profile details and order history.
pages.faqPastOrdersQ: Where can I see past orders?
pages.faqPastOrdersA: Past orders are available from your profile orders page after checkout.
